From: Emily Huang <e.huang@quantumhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: SOC 2 evidence request + audit-period clarification

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this — Quantum Health's InfoSec team is working through our vendor qualification for the upcoming integration. We reviewed the SOC 2 Type II report linked in your portal, but we have a few follow-ups we need to validate before we can move to a procurement recommendation. Could you confirm the answers below and provide the indicated artifacts?

1) Audit period: can you confirm the exact period covered by the Type II report (start/end dates)? We need to make sure it covers our required window (2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31). If the report ends earlier, would Redwood be able to provide a bridge letter covering the gap?

2) MFA controls: we need configuration evidence demonstrating enforcement for user/admin logins (policy screenshot and an export/list of authentication methods enabled). A redacted configuration screenshot and an explanation of any exceptions is sufficient.

3) Access reviews: sample artifact showing periodic access review for privileged accounts (CSV or PDF) and the cadence/process notes (who signs off).

4) Administrative access logs: a sliced sample of admin console activity (last 90 days) tied to the access review sample — redacted for PII is fine.

5) Can you confirm retention windows for auth logs and whether these are stored in a system accessible via secure export? We may request a secure transfer if needed.

If you can send an inventory of what you can provide and how soon (and any limitations), that would be great. We can accept a combination of attachments and secure Drive/SFTP delivery.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Huang
Senior Security Analyst, Quantum Health

- MFA: we can provide a redacted config screenshot and a CSV export of user auth methods for the slice you request (subject to redaction).
- Access reviews: we'll attach a sanitized sample from Q2 2026 and describe the cadence/process.
- Admin logs: we can deliver a 90-day slice via secure SFTP or encrypted Drive link; we'll redact personal data.
- Retention: auth logs are retained for 12 months in our centralized logging pipeline; we can export the slices you need.

Attachments: I'll attach a short note on what we normally provide as evidence. For the heavier log exports, Vivek will follow up with options and timelines.

Can you confirm whether the bridge letter is acceptable and whether CSV is your preferred format for access review samples?

Best,

Emily, Hannah — thanks. Technical follow-up from Security.

We can provide the following artifacts and delivery options:

1) SOC 2 bridge letter: we can produce a dated bridge letter covering 2026-08-31 that references the controls in the 2025–2026 report and states no material changes were made to the control environment since the report end date. Legal will review standard language; ETA for a signed letter is ~5 business days after you confirm acceptance of the wording.

2) MFA controls: attached is a redacted screenshot of the admin policy page showing 2FA enforcement and device enrollment requirements. We will also provide an exported table (CSV) with account_id (hashed), auth_methods, last_mfa_enrollment_date for the sample window. See attached sample file name in the metadata.

3) Access reviews: we run quarterly privileged access reviews. I will attach a sanitized Q2-2026 CSV export that shows account id, role, date reviewed, and reviewer initials. That should meet your audit sampling needs.

4) Admin log slices: we can produce time-bounded slices (e.g., 2026-08-15 through 2026-11-01) and remove PII fields. For delivery, we offer: (a) encrypted Drive link, (b) secure SFTP drop, or (c) vendor portal temporary token. If you pick SFTP we will schedule a transfer and provide MD5 checksums.

5) Retention: logs retained 12 months in our logging bucket; critical auth events are forwarded to our SIEM for 13 months. We will include retention-policy excerpts.

Notes/constraints: we cannot share raw unredacted UUIDs or full user email addresses for privacy reasons; we will provide hashed ids and clear mapping methodology. Also, anything that touches customer data in raw form requires a separate NDA/transfer agreement; admin/auth logs do not contain customer PII in our standard exports but we will flag anything unusual before transfer.

Attaching: mfa_config_screenshot.png (redacted), access_review_2026_Q2.csv (sanitized sample). Full SOC 2 PDF is available in the portal; I will attach the official Type II PDF on request.

Thanks Vivek/Hannah — that's helpful. A few clarifications from our end so we can coordinate with procurement:

- Bridge letter: yes, a bridge letter that attests to "no material changes" through 2026-08-31 is acceptable. Please include the signed date and name of the Redwood signatory.
- Access review sample: CSV is preferred. We will need at least one quarterly snapshot that includes reviewer name/role. Redaction of user emails is acceptable if you supply a deterministic hashed id and a note explaining hashing algorithm.
- Admin log slice: we request a 90-day slice covering 2026-08-01 to 2026-10-30. If retention limits prevent exact dates, send the latest contiguous 90-day window and note the window you provided. SFTP is preferred.
- Redaction & legal: we understand redaction constraints. Please mark any fields removed for privacy reasons and provide a redaction legend.

Can you also confirm an expected delivery timeline for: (A) bridge letter, (B) CSV access review, (C) admin log slice via SFTP? Our procurement target is to complete vendor risk review by 2026-11-19.

Thanks,
Emily
